payload.title: CI Set up Rust step intermittently fails installing clippy
payload.description: Twice on 2026-10-19 the performance job failed in its 'Set up Rust' step before any Kanbus code ran: 'error: failed to install component: clippy-preview-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu, detected conflict: bin/cargo-clippy' (runs 39264684333 on PR #468 and 39339097268 on the 0.37.0 release push to main). A failed main run blocks semantic-release until someone reruns the job. Likely cause: dtolnay/rust-toolchain installs components while rust-toolchain.toml (channel 1.88.0, components rustfmt, clippy, llvm-tools-preview) triggers a second rustup install of the same components on the runner image's preinstalled toolchain. Fix one way for every job: either rely on rust-toolchain.toml alone (rustup show / rustup toolchain install from the file) or pass the same toolchain and components in the action and nowhere else; then verify across a few runs. Acceptance: no Set up Rust failures over 20 consecutive CI runs.
